Type designation CD
Accuracy class C3 C4
Maximum number of intervals nLC 3000 4000
Maximum capacity Emax 25t, 30t, 40t, 60t, 100t

Excitation voltage Uexc 5-15 Vac/dc

Temperature rating Tmin / Tmax -10 °C / +40 °C
